annotations.shape: a Date claiming 2025-03-04T16:00:00Z beside a simulated file mtime of 2025-03-06T09:12:00Z -- TimeEvent conflict case 4 of 5 (D15: filesystem time is not evidence of arrival)
annotations.generator: tools/make_fixtures.py, from _fixture_date_vs_mtime; the mtime is simulated and lives in the hand-typed artifact (kind fs_mtime, source property st_mtime), because a fixture file cannot carry its own filesystem times
annotations.phase_numbering: the design document's phases: 0 = the Phase 0 skeleton walker, 1 = the Phase 1 parser, 2 = routing and statuses, 3 = threading and time evidence -- every time.* fact here is phase 3
annotations.the_evidence: e_mtime carries trust=filesystem and usable_for_arrival_ordering=false exactly as D15 prescribes: the event is recorded (it happened) but no evidence policy may place it; e_date is a normal claimed Date
annotations.the_policies: header_date_claimed places only e_date and reports the mtime not placed (it is not arrival-usable); received_chain_header_order covers no hops and places nothing; owner_manifest is the labelled total-order override and IS allowed to place the mtime -- an owner may know when a non-email file arrived (the arrival manifest only the owner can supply, trust=user_supplied)
annotations.the_conflicts: the pair is unresolved because the Date and the filesystem clock name two different moments and nothing merges them (D15: evidence is never merged into one true time); the pair is recorded even though the mtime cannot enter an order -- a disagreement the rules resolve by exclusion is still a disagreement between the claims
annotations.labels_are_typed: typed by a model from D15 and the fixture's declared shape, never copied out of tests/support/timeline_ref.py or the library; labels_provenance is spec

value: the Date claims 2025-03-04T16:00:00Z while the simulated file mtime is 2025-03-06T09:12:00Z: filesystem time is not evidence of arrival (usable_for_arrival_ordering=false) and nothing merges it with the claimed Date -- the two claims name two moments and stay side by side
